thread:
andrew: planning an indexed TTL rollout on user_events during a maintenance window. aim: add partial index, backfill in safe batches, enable TTL enforcement, then remove legacy compaction job. requesting a 2-hour window.
kim: @andrew can you post row estimates + whether this needs a full quiesce? we should pin API/web versions during the critical period.
andrew: estimate ~12M rows. backfill strategy: batch updates, parallel across shards. concurrent index create + partial condition should avoid table locks. proposed window 02:00-04:00 UTC. quiesce ~2m per shard to drain writers.
sara: support pinning. also need vacuum/analyze after index build. any known lock risk from existing triggers?
dbadmin: using CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY + partial predicate to limit locking. predicate: WHERE status != 'deleted' AND created_at < now() - interval '90 days'. backfill will be UPDATE-in-chunks. sample DDL:

```
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_user_events_ttl ON user_events (created_at) WHERE (created_at < now() - interval '90 days' AND status != 'deleted');
```

mike: deploy-bot scheduled a migration job stub. deploy-bot: Migration job 82421 created by andrew, tentative window 2056789123-2056796400.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by andrew for channel eng-releases: migration/82421 created. Canary: api-canary-2. Lock status: none.
kim: can we route canary writes to a follower first? prefer to exercise the index on replica before primaries.
andrew: good call. set canary to replica for the first step.
kim: route flag example:

```
route-migration --id 82421 --canary api-canary-2 --use-replica
```
sara: add abort conditions in the runbook: replication lag > 30s for >5m, error spike >1% for 10m.
dbadmin: preflight checklist:
- backup snapshot (db-main) before 2056789200
- restore smoke test in staging
- run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on representative queries
- ensure pg_repack not scheduled during window
andrew: backups scheduled at 2056789200. I'll trigger smoke canary after index build but before enabling TTL.
mike: rollout notes: pin web/api to v3.14.2 for the quiesce. release blurb: "Indexed TTL rollout for user_events to reduce storage; partial index + TTL enforcement."
nina: I'll prepare the quiesce script to drain short-lived writers: /scripts/quiesce_user_events.sh. ready to run on short notice.
andrew: quiesce plan (2m):
1) set app maintenance flag
2) wait 120s for inflight requests to drain
3) start concurrent index build
4) run backfill in bounded batches
5) enable TTL enforcement
6) clear flag
kim: escape hatch command: `deploy-bot abort migration 82421`. ensure on-call has perms.
deploy-bot: Migration 82421 progress: queued -> index build started (0%). watch: https://internal/deploys/82421
dbadmin: monitoring: watch replication lag, IOPS, long queries. if any advisory locks appear, we stop and assess.
sara: I'll be primary on-call during the window. eng-oncall channel notified.
mike: rollback triggers: replication lag >30s for 5m, error rate >1% for 10m, p95 latency >500ms for 10m. Documented in release notes.
andrew: small change: need extra time for backup, propose shifting window to 02:30-04:30 UTC. anyone object?
kim: OK with 02:30-04:30. i'll update schedule and pin versions.
deploy-bot: migration 82421 rescheduled by kim. New start 2056791000 (02:30 UTC). New window 2056791000-2056798200.
sara: logging checklist items in the release notes channel. will post the runbook link.
nina: quiesce script is staged at commit sha: a1b2c3. I'll stand by to execute.
dbadmin: once index hits ~30% I'll run a restore smoke test against the latest backup to validate recovery. also running ANALYZE afterwards recommended.
andrew: after index build completes I want a short canary write test (10k ops) against api-canary-2 before flipping TTL on.
mike: ops: pin versions during canary and quiesce, update changelog with rollback criteria and quick restore steps.
kim: will also notify product and marketing about the minor downtime window for docs.
deploy-bot: migration 82421 progress: index build 12% -> 52% -> 100%. awaiting canary verification.
sara: canary tests passed. no increased errors. replication lag steady <5s.
andrew: enabling TTL now.
deploy-bot: migration 82421 action: TTL enforcement enabled. Monitoring window open.
dbadmin: post-run: schedule `VACUUM VERBOSE` and `ANALYZE` on user_events during low traffic tonight.
nina: cleared maintenance flag. scripts/report generated at https://internal/reports/82421
mike: closing notes: storage down ~28% on sample shard. follow-up: monitor long-term compaction over next 7 days.
sara: thanks all. filing a short postmortem anchor in postmortems if we need it. :white_check_mark:
andrew: thanks team — will update the migration ticket and close once monitoring stalls for 24h."
